## Archer and Walt Disney Imagineering R&D Launch Research Collaboration, Unveil Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday-Themed Midnight Aircraft at F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix


Nov 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/823642595/files/doc_news/Archer-and-Walt-Disney-Imagineering-RD-Launch-Research-Collaboration-Unveil-Marvel-Studios-Avengers-Doomsday-Themed-Midnight-Aircraft-8ZUNN.pdf)


- Archer and Walt Disney Imagineering R&D are beginning early, exploratory research, bringing together a shared spirit of innovation and imagination focused on the future of transportation.
- Archer’s Midnight aircraft made an appearance at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix featuring Avengers: Doomsday and Disney branding to launch the collaboration


Archer and Walt Disney Imagineering R&D announced a collaboration reflecting a broader spirit of imagination and innovation that connects Archer’s work in aviation with the creative world of Disney. Building on that shared interest, Archer Aviation Inc., a company developing electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and Walt Disney Imagineering R&D are beginning early, exploratory research together. The initial effort creates an opportunity for the teams to learn and explore creative, technical, and experiential concepts, pioneering ideas for the future of transportation.


Disney Imagineering and Archer kicked off the collaboration at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix as Archer Aviation’s Midnight aircraft, featuring a custom *Avengers: Doomsday* and Disney-branded livery. The appearance brought Archer’s aircraft into the spotlight at one of the world’s most recognizable sporting and entertainment events and is part of Archer’s previously announced global air taxi partnership with Formula 1.


From the Las Vegas Grand Prix to these initial research conversations, the collaboration brings together aviation, storytelling, and innovation, with an emphasis on exploring what may be possible in the future.


**About Archer**


Archer builds the aircraft and core technologies that will define the next era of flight for aerospace and defense. To learn more, visit[www.archer.com](https://www.archer.com/) .


**About Marvel Studios’ “Avengers: Doomsday”**


In Marvel Studios’ “Avengers: Doomsday,” beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they’ve ever encountered.


The film, which is directed by Anthony and Joe Russo and written by Stephen McFeely and Michael Waldron, is produced by Kevin Feige, Louis D’Esposito and Jonathan Schwartz, and stars Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie, Florence Pugh, Vanessa Kirby, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Wyatt Russell, Channing Tatum, Simu Liu, Ian McKellen, Hayley Atwell, Tom Hiddleston, James Marsden, Patrick Stewart, Joseph Quinn, Sebastian Stan, David Harbour, Letitia Wright, Lewis Pullman, Kelsey Grammer, Kathryn Newton, Danny Ramirez, Winston Duke, Alan Cumming, Hannah John-Kamen, Rebecca Romijn, Alex Livinalli, Mabel Cadena, with Tenoch Huerta Mejia. “Avengers: Doomsday” releases in theaters December 18, 2026.
